About SIMCA

SIMCA (legal name Real Estate SIMCA SAPI de CV) is a Mexican developer working across the Yucatán Peninsula and Tabasco, with sales offices in Mérida, Playa del Carmen and Tulum. Beyond housing, it runs divisions for industrial and logistics parks, retail and business space. Its residential catalogue ranges from large lot subdivisions and golf communities around Mérida to apartment buildings near the beach in Playa del Carmen.

In Tulum, SIMCA concentrates on mid-size condominium buildings in established residential zones. Costa Caribe sits in Aldea Zamá, between the town and the beach; Gran Tulum is located inside Inmobilia's Tulum 101 master plan; and Natal is in La Veleta. Earlier Tulum projects include Querido Tulum, designed with the studio Reyes Ríos + Larraín and nominated for ArchDaily's Building of the Year, and Prana. The company also operates a vacation-rental and property-management program for owners.

Key areas of activity

  • Residential condominiums
  • Residential lot subdivisions
  • Industrial and logistics parks
  • Retail and commercial space
  • Property management and vacation rentals
